evals.prompt: 帮我搜一下最近一周关于AI Agent的新闻，中文的，要5条就行，总结一下主要趋势
evals.expected_output: Agent uses volcengine-web-search with --json --count 5 --time-range week --need-summary, searches for AI Agent related query in Chinese, and provides a summary of trends from the results.

evals.prompt: 我想了解最新的新能源汽车政策，要权威来源的信息
